candidates.name: peaker_peak_blocks
candidates.reason: Trim the high-cost small peakers to the two demand peaks while preserving the incumbent larger-unit blocks and extra evening ramp support.

candidates.name: shorter_85mw_blocks
candidates.reason: Combine peaker trimming with shorter 85 MW blocks, starting that unit before each peak to provide ramp support while removing its low-load initial and tail commitments.

candidates.name: shoulder_and_tail_trim
candidates.reason: Remove additional 80 MW shoulder commitments and the final two hours of one 130 MW unit; retain the 85 MW unit longer after midday to accommodate coordinated ramp-down.

candidates.name: earlier_midmerit_return
candidates.reason: Move the fourth unit's five-hour outage to the start, bringing cheaper capacity back earlier and delaying the 85 MW startup; combine this with shoulder and tail trims guided by the local decommit estimates.
